description: ResampleFwd (pooling, no index output) in the HIP_MLOPS_ENGINE region: rank 4 or 5, NCHW/NCDHW or NHWC/NDHWC packed strides, float/half/bfloat16 for x and y alike, maxpool and both avgpool modes, per-dimension window 1..5, stride 1..4 and pre/post padding 0..3 (asymmetric padding and padding of a window or more included, as long as the window fits the padded input). Template: quick ResampleFwd/Variant2, the plain tensor set (x and y, no index tensor, generate_index false, zero_pad); neg_inf_pad needs the index topology of Default and is not drawn here. The domain axis fills x, and the nan and inf domains poison x itself: a pooled output element reads only its own window, so a non-finite x element stays local to the windows covering it. Max pooling over a NaN is not defined by the API and the two sides disagree: the HIP kernel never selects a NaN (ResampleFwd.cpp:157, candidate > result is false), the CPU reference keeps a NaN only when it is the first element of the window (CpuFpReferenceResampleFwd.hpp:91, !selectedCandidate selects it unconditionally). The nan domain therefore plants +infinity under maxpool, where both agree; the avgpool modes sum the window and propagate NaN on both sides. The alignment axis declares that alignment on x and y (uids 1, 0) through tensor_patches, and the placement axis puts the device pointers at exactly that alignment (exact) or misaligns x (placement_uid 1) below it, a case that passes only if the backend rejects it (under, drawn as exact at alignment 1); default leaves the pointers where they are.

derive.od: (d + pre_d + post_d - win_d) // str_d + 1 if ndim == 5 else 1
derive.dims_x: [n, c, h, w] if ndim == 4 else [n, c, d, h, w]
derive.dims_y: [n, c, oh, ow] if ndim == 4 else [n, c, od, oh, ow]
derive.xs_h: w if layout == 'nchw' else w * c
derive.xs_d: h * w if layout == 'nchw' else h * w * c
derive.xs_c: d * h * w if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.ys_h: ow if layout == 'nchw' else ow * c
derive.ys_d: oh * ow if layout == 'nchw' else oh * ow * c
derive.ys_c: od * oh * ow if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.stride_x: [xs_n, xs_c, xs_h, xs_w] if ndim == 4 else [xs_n, xs_c, xs_d, xs_h, xs_w]
derive.stride_y: [ys_n, ys_c, ys_h, ys_w] if ndim == 4 else [ys_n, ys_c, ys_d, ys_h, ys_w]
derive.window: [win_h, win_w] if ndim == 4 else [win_d, win_h, win_w]
derive.pool_stride: [str_h, str_w] if ndim == 4 else [str_d, str_h, str_w]
derive.pre_pad: [pre_h, pre_w] if ndim == 4 else [pre_d, pre_h, pre_w]
derive.post_pad: [post_h, post_w] if ndim == 4 else [post_d, post_h, post_w]
derive.dom_kind: 'fixed' if domain == 'constant' else ('special' if domain in ['nan', 'inf'] else ('free' if domain in ['default', 'narrow', 'wide', 'positive'] else domain))
derive.dom_lo: -0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (-8 if domain == 'wide' else (0.25 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else -1)))
derive.dom_hi: 0.01 if domain == 'narrow' else (8 if domain == 'wide' else (4 if domain == 'positive' else (0.5 if domain == 'constant' else 1)))
derive.dom_special: 'inf' if domain == 'inf' or (domain == 'nan' and mode == 'maxpool') else 'nan'
derive.eff_placement: 'exact' if placement == 'under' and alignment < 2 else placement

constraints.rule: h + pre_h + post_h >= win_h and w + pre_w + post_w >= win_w and (ndim == 4 or d + pre_d + post_d >= win_d)
constraints.reason: the output extent (x + pre + post - window) / stride + 1 is the one hip-kernel-provider accepts (ResamplePlanUtils.hpp:131-133 validateResampleOutputShape, ResampleApplicabilityChecks.cpp:84-97) and the frontend infers (ResampleFwdNode.hpp:116); it is defined for a window that fits the padded input only, because C++ integer division truncates toward zero and would give 1 for a window that overhangs the padded input
GPU reference cost ceiling on the input (RFC 0023 section 14)

constraints.rule: n * c * od * oh * ow * wvol <= 2**30
constraints.reason: GPU reference cost ceiling on the pooled work: every output element reads one window (ResampleFwd.cpp:122-169; RFC 0023 section 14)
